summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO across the Lantern March, with Lantern's Reach as hub and race/class stories spanning streamed regions. MMORPG Tools owns character, realm and UI lifecycle; ordered player behaviors combine movement, four classes, quests, trade, flight and vitality, while scene bindings and YAML registries define world content and cumulative XP drives level-derived stats.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - realm roster and entry for Enter World and character creation.
places/character-creation-land/ - race/class/appearance selection with preview character and creation camera.
places/main/config.yaml - continent terrain, regions, roads, scatter and atmosphere; streamed cells hold landmarks and interactions.

places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub and services, residents, quests, Shield Table, Observatory, chapter sites and the Unseen Door (Old Bond House, Keeper Sen Arlo, SHA quest props and yard drills).

places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene, x-5z0.scene, x-5z1.scene, x-6z0.scene, x0z-1.scene, x1z0.scene, x7z-1.scene, x7z-2.scene, x2z11.scene - Briarwild/Briarkin content, northern March landmarks, Emberstone Quarry/Cinderhold, Gullrest's Saltborn …
places/main/cells/x-9z6.scene, x-10z6..8.scene, x-11z6..7.scene - Sorrowfen around Mourner Pool: stilt village, act-one marks, drowned chapel, Orla's skiff, Mirelurker pool and echo-story sites.

places/main/cells/x-10z15.scene, x-5z16..17.scene, x-6z15..16.scene, x-7z15.scene, x-8z14..15.scene, x-9z15.scene - Tideglass Coast: quay, lighthouse, Lost-Fleet shore, lens bench, memory nets/brine collector, song beacons and estuary land…
places/hollowcrypt/ - separate underground dungeon entered from the mausoleum in main cell x10z-5; crypt halls, archive, Warden, Vale/Elric, candles and echoes live in its cells.
roots: world.config.yaml - main-menu-land default entry; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, cameras, character/interaction behaviors and UI actions.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, Vanguard, Arcanist, Pathfinder, Shade, quest, vendor, flight and vitality behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera template; MMORPG has separate creation and menu camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml - owns continent terrain and regional surface/scatter configuration; cells contribute local structures and interactions.
places/hollowcrypt/config.yaml - owns dungeon gravity, dark atmosphere, lighting and place configuration; cells bind crypt geometry and encounters.
mods/gavi/mod.json - registers Gavi crew behavior and panel, the builder-facing companion tools.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors, gameplay scripts and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character load/upsert/delete and roster population shared by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - room registry read by routing and realm-pulse; IDs align with realm-save.js.

scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest definitions, eligibility/progress/status shared by quest-player, quest-giver and quest UI; includes class path SHA-01..07 alongside origin, EQU/DHC, SOR and TID campaigns.
scripts/lib/economy.js + MMORPG lib/currency.js - integer-copper transactions/ledger and denomination formatting shared by quests, vendor, flight and UI.
scripts/lib/regions.js + scripts/terrain-reach.js - regional classification and continent height/material generation used by terrain and region display, including Sorrowfen and Tideglass Coast.
scripts/lib/data/flights.yml - roost coordinates, regions, discovery radius, fare/speed limits and clearance read by flight behavior and UI.
scripts/lib/leveling.js + scripts/lib/data/levels.yml - total-XP progression table and derived level/stats shared by quest-player and HUD/frame XP displays.
notableExports: scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; crons/realm-pulse.js - cron.
MMORPG main-menu-mgr.js - roster selection/hydration and lifecycle; character-select.js - preview lifecycle and input; player.js - character build/save/load lifecycle.
MMORPG ui.js - UI composition/actions; lib/ui-quest.js - quest dialog/turn-in/tracker renderers; lib/version.js - game version/title/tag exports (0.25.3 Alpha).
MMORPG lib/ui-hud.js - renderTargetDisplay, renderHUD; class-aware action bar presents the class kit and cooldown sweep in slots 1-3 unless overridden by saved spellBar entries.
scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - gait; scripts/vitality.js - scheduled fall/rise and health-mending update.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput/update; scripts/elric.js and scripts/townsfolk.js - resident behavior; scripts/lib/economy.js - realmOf, ledger, feedback, move.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - class combat handlers; scripts/shade.js - onInput, land, update, veiled, unveil, endAction; scripts/lib/kit.js - class/combat helpers.
scripts/flight.js - updateSchedule, onInput, update; scripts/lib/leveling.js - levelInfo, statsFor, LEVEL_TOTALS.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including discovered roosts and quest state.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js, pathfinder.js and shade.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; Shade stores veiledUntil on player state and transient readiness/ambush windows in session.

scripts/quest-player.js - quest/tally, inventory/xp/dialog/cache state, quest marks/flags, deferred owedItems and quest travel transitions; derives level/xp progress/max stats from XP and persists changed character state.
scripts/lib/leveling.js - derives level, XP within level, next-level requirement and max health/mana; levels.yml owns progression anchors, growth, cap and stat increments.
scripts/lib/economy.js - coin movement, purse floor and ledger writes; scripts/vendor.js owns shop state and transaction handling.
scripts/flight.js - per-player discovered roosts, flightMap, flying/landing state and nearby-roost hint; scripts/gryphon-flight.js owns spawned mount route and rider landing.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → main gameplay lifecycle.

Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to menu; menu Enter/Create and scripts/crypt-gate.js stamp transition exceptions.
main-menu-mgr loads current room SQL roster and population; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main.
scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js read realms.yml; room cron writes player count to realm_pulse, which realm-save reads for roster UI.

Character creation race/class → lib/races.js race start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to realm characters table keyed by user, realm and slot; Shade is an available fourth class.

templates/player.js order → locomotion → movement → class handlers including Shade → quest-player → vendor → flight → vitality; moveX/moveZ/jump and camera intents are consumed by player.js/wow-move.js under place gravity.

Class action-bar defaults → ui-hud.js fills empty/attack slots 1–3 from class kit; number keys dispatch actions to class handlers, whose state.cd cooldown keys drive kit cooldown sweeps; saved spellBar choices take precedence.

Shade hotbar attack/castSlot2/castSlot3 → scripts/shade.js Strike/Shadowstep/Veil; Strike writes target hp and hit-credit state, Shadowstep relocates the player, Veil sets veiledUntil and Shade drill marks/tallies.
Veiled player state.veiledUntil → wolves.js, scavengers.js and candle-warden.js exclude that player from fighter/target selection; scripts/shade.js update expires the veil and Strike breaks it.
Attack/cast inputs → class abilities and scripts/lib/missiles.js → targets/enemies; wolves.js, configurable scavengers.js and candle-warden.js consume combat state and issue damage/kill credits.

Interact/E → quest-player resolves NPCs, talkers, readable props, caches, timber and quest-mark objects; a ready quest mark is handled before a nearby quest-giver, otherwise giver chat takes precedence over waiting marks; townsfolk.yml state.who supplies NPC dialogue.

quests.yml → quest-data eligibility/progress/status → quest-player and quest-giver/UI; ui-quest maps giver IDs to place/coordinates for nearby quest marks after a six-second stream-in delay; SHA-01..07 are Shade-only sequential objectives and use Unseen Door scene marks plus shade-drill sentries/posts.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/ landmark builders reuse scripts/gen/shape.js procedural geometry helpers, varied by landmark and parameters; crypt.js supplies Hollowcrypt halls, rooms and furniture.
scripts/gen/fen.js - procedural marsh props reused by Sorrowfen cells, varied by kind/seed/LOD; boardwalk geometry and collider share length/width/elevation parameters.
scripts/gen/tide.js - Tideglass structures and props share shape helpers; kind/LOD/length/width vary each piece.
scripts/gen/unseen.js - Old Bond House, yard wall, mirrors, case, dead drops and quest props share procedural geometry/material helpers, varied by params.kind and LOD.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, mushroom.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by layer density, scale, seed or per-item params.
scripts/gen/tree.js with scripts/tree-look.js - painted bark/alpha-cut foliage recur in forest layers and placed scatters, varied by tree kind and LOD.
MMORPG player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json; camera phases and lib/ui-* renderers are modular and composed by ui.js.
scripts/wolves.js and scripts/scavengers.js share roam/chase/attack/leash/death patterns; both omit players whose Shade Veil has not expired.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through scripts/lib/economy.js to preserve purse floor, ledger and UI feedback.
templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion before movement, then class handlers including Shade, quests, vendor, flight and vitality; gait samples prior-tick velocity.
Movement intent/locomotion scratch is room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.
scripts/lib/data/levels.yml anchors total cumulative XP at campaign bands; state.xp remains cumulative while xpInto/xpToLevel are current-bar values; progression cap is 60.

Shade Veil stores an expiry timestamp in player.state.veiledUntil; wolves, scavengers and Candle Warden explicitly filter active Veil, so keep the key and expiry comparison aligned with Shade's millisecond cooldown/timer state.

SHA drills are scene tags shade-drill with state.need, quest and tallyKey; shade.js marks each entity+quest once in state.marks and saves its tally. Quest marks use state.quest/state.mark and state.after gating; E counts only active incomplete objectives and ready marks outrank nearby quest NPCs. ui-quest.js NPC_POS uses world x/z and place IDs with 90 m proximity and a 6 s stream-in wait, so update it when givers move; HUD kit cooldown entries depend on matching state.cd keys and fill only empty or attack spellBar slots.
